title: Aptote
summary: AP'TOTE, noun [Gr. priv, and case.] In grammar, a noun which has no variation of termination, or distinction of cases; an indeclinable noun.

inlines.v: AP'TOTE, noun [Gr. priv, and case.] In grammar, a noun which has no variation of termination, or distinction of cases; an indeclinable noun.
